svg.text: FFL 1673.60 · Reading-bay house · from owner's A
Orange dashed = different from the other option(s)
1:100 at A3 · field frame rotated to grid north · contours 1 m from survey TIN
Same clear arrival as option 1: SW court, west
door, square entry, then the family hall with
the stair and lift in view (rule 2.6).
Owner's A idea of a quiet NE reading/prayer
bay is kept. It becomes the closed north arm
of an L-shaped living room (rules 3.1 and
3.3): sofas in the SE, prayer mats facing SSW
Master bedroom sits in the middle of the north
side, the quietest spot on the plan (rule
6.5). Its lobby comes off the hall. The
ensuite, linen and dressing room open from
Kitchen with island on the south, slider to
the south terrace, semi-open with two portals
(rules 1.1 and 1.3). Dining sits beside it for
Terraces wrap the house south and east, all on
the roof of the lower floor (rule 4.3).
